about: What each run of scripts/tools/autoplay_all.sh must show. play_time is the play time (h:mm:ss) last measured in the villaclaro-autoplay skill and play_time_margin the % it may move; timeout_min is wall-clock minutes. A release that changes the balance updates this file with the skill. Without jq the script reads it line by line: keep each run, known_warnings and play_time_margin on one line.
